# MikkTSpace

Vendored reference [MikkTSpace](https://github.com/mmikk/MikkTSpace) tangent
generator by Morten S. Mikkelsen, pinned in `SOURCE-LOCK.json`. Ludus::SceneCook
uses it privately to generate tangents for best-effort glTF/OBJ imports; see
[best-effort scene import](../../docs/development/best-effort-scene-import.md).
